beats.text: Slovakia's middle class earns 19.3 percent of national income. Colombia has 11.5.
Colombia has a lower share. A small slice for the middle of the population.
Zambia and Zimbabwe are also near the bottom. Zambia has 11.9 percent. Zimbabwe, 12.
This is the share that accrues to the middle quintile of the population.
Moving up, the USA has 15.1 percent. Indonesia has 15.5. Nigeria, 16.4.
Slovakia is the world's highest. With 19.3 percent, it has 1.7 times Colombia's share.
How large is the middle class share where you live?
